captions: The largest share of housing in {city}, {SS} was built {peak}, at {peak_value} of the stock. Weather decides when pests move; the building decides whether they get in. Older sill plates, settled slabs and worn weather-stripping are the routes most infestations use.

In {city}, homes built {peak} make up {peak_value} of the housing. Decades of freeze-thaw and wet-dry cycles open gaps around foundations and utility penetrations — the same seasonal pressure that moves pests also makes older structures easier to enter.
{peak} accounts for {peak_value} of {city}'s homes. Age determines the entry points, and entry points are what turn seasonal pest pressure outside into an infestation inside.
